cmd:
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git pull -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
bash scripts/check_cabinet.sh 2>&1 | tail -2
python3 - <<'PY'
c = open('/root/Caddyfile').read()
if 'handle /cabinet-*' in c:
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c); print('CADDY: ВЖЕ Є')
else:
    c2 = c.replace("\thandle /cabinet-log* {\n\t\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8793\n\t}\n",
                   "\thandle /cabinet-* {\n\t\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8793\n\t}\n")
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c2)
    print('CADDY: РОЗШИРЕНО' if c2 != c else 'CADDY: НЕ ЗНАЙШОВ БЛОК')
PY
cp /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.bak-cabview-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
diff /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.new
if docker run --rm -v /root/Caddyfile.new:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro caddy:2-alpine \
     caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/tmp/cv3.log 2>&1; then
  echo VALIDATE_OK
  cp /root/Caddyfile.new /root/Caddyfile
  docker exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo RELOAD_OK
else
  echo VALIDATE_FAIL; tail -3 /tmp/cv3.log
fi
systemctl restart unitex-cabinet && sleep 3
echo "служба: $(systemctl is-active unitex-cabinet)"
echo "== без прав =="
echo "  /cabinet-clients: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://134.209.94.12/cabinet-clients)"
echo "  /cabinet-view:    $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://134.209.94.12/cabinet-view -d 'client=ГРАНД МАРИН')"
echo "  /as без токена:   $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'https://cabinet.unitex.od.ua/as?t=')"
echo "  /set без токена:  $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'https://cabinet.unitex.od.ua/set?t=')"
